title.zh: 【何一：仍需通过正式流程取回冻结的 30 亿美元资产】

current_state.zh: He Yi said Binance's $6.3 billion in available funds now covers all stolen assets, while roughly $3 billion of frozen funds still has to be recovered through a formal process.
